In [[geometry]], the '''tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|83}}}}). It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with three [[pentagonal cupola]]e removed.
[[File:J83 tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]]
{{Johnson solid}}

Related Johnson solids are:
* {{math|''J''{{sub|76}}}}: [[diminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with one cupola removed,
* {{math|''J''{{sub|80}}}}: [[parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two opposing cupolae removed,
* {{math|''J''{{sub|81}}}}: [[metabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two non-opposing cupolae removed, and
* {{math|''J''{{sub|82}}}}: [[gyrate bidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two non-opposing cupolae removed and one cupola rotated 36 degrees.
